text:
This tattoo studio is extremely professional, and the owner is a really nice, interesting person. The tattoo artist Mimi has outstanding skills. I’m fully satisfied with everything from custom design work to the actual tattooing process.

On top of that, the shop is impeccably clean, ensuring customers a worry‑free experience. I’ve gotten all my tattoos done right here. If you’re in Chiang Mai and planning to get inked, this place is an absolute top pick!

Had such a great experience here!
Artist Im is incredibly precise - super steady hands, clean lines, and amazing attention to detail. Most importantly… she’s gorgeous too 😆✨

The whole team was so caring and professional. I brought my two kids (3 & 6 years old) with me, and even after waiting for more than 3 hours, everything went smoothly because the staff helped look after them so well.

Very professional, clean, spacious, and comfortable studio. Honestly one of the best tattoo experiences I’ve had. Highly recommend! 🖤

We had such a great experience here! I had two cover ups done after almost thirty years. We couldn't be happier. The whole team was caring and very informative, and made our first tattoos in Thailand a memory we won't forget!! We highly recommend this shop and would come back again next time we are in Chiang Mai.

My partner and I happened to walk by this place, and we just had to take a quick look. That quick look turned into three tattoos over multiple days! I even got my first tattoo here, and it turned out absolutely amazing. Patrick and the lovely artists really make you feel at home, they took great care of us and made the whole experience super comfortable. I felt totally free to ask any questions without feeling judged. Would definitely recommend this spot if you're in Chiang Mai and thinking about getting inked!

It was a real good experience, from the moment I texted the shop to the end result. they where Quick to response and the next day I could get the tattoo done! Felt welcome in the shop and they took perfect time to make the stencil right without feeling rushed. If you want a break its fine, there is even complimentary drinks and snacks! The shop is really clean and there is a chill vibe.

I would recommend this shop for some quality work done!

I had an amazing experience at Artisan Ink Tattoo in Chiang Mai. From the moment I walked in, the entire staff was incredibly welcoming, professional, and genuinely fun to be around. They immediately made me feel comfortable and took the time to understand exactly what I wanted.

The team is clearly extremely skilled and knowledgeable. They helped me refine the design, gave great advice, and made sure every detail was perfect before starting. You can really tell they care about their craft.

The quality of the tattoo is outstanding — the lines are clean, the details are precise, and the overall result is simply perfect. They truly have an incredible hand and a level of precision that shows years of experience.

On top of that, the atmosphere in the studio is great: relaxed, friendly, and very professional at the same time. It made the whole experience even better.

If you're looking for a tattoo in Chiang Mai, I absolutely recommend Artisan Ink. Amazing artists, great energy, and flawless work. I couldn’t be happier with the result!

If you're looking for some new ink in Chiang Mai, look no further! Very clean and professional,  Patrick and his team are willing and capable of helping you get that perfect Tattoo! Ive tried a few shops in CM before finding Artisan Ink, and this shop exceeds expectations every time! Easy to communicate on WhatsApp or line, make your appointment today...you won't be disappointed!

I could go on all day about how magnificient the service is here.
Long story short - Immaculate shop - quite cheap, fair price and affordable. I left with a feeling of every penny being worth it!
Fluency in English - so no need to worry being lost in translation for your ideas of interest.
Heartwarming service - Patrick and Co. are extremely helpful and considerate making sure you literally feel at home in the shop. Everytime I return to Chiang Mai I will definitely come visit each time, even if it's just for a chatter with the team (that's how welcoming they are)

Professionalism and perfection:
The team will make sure everything sits right, by adjusting size and details before ink'ing and Patrick always make sure you feel comfortable before proceeding.
If you are like me and you are very cautious/mildy perfectionistic then superb - Patrick had no issues with me changing somethings up on the go as he finalized the idea with his editing software. Besides, the team wants to make sure they have the correct size you want - something you are happy with before proceeding.
The artists have sage-like hands-on experience with tattooing because my lord is their work flabbergasting!

Hygiene - Absolutely perfect. They care for your tattoo's health before, during and after. Colors are super clean and looks astonishing once finished.
Communication and guidance - Patrick's genius mind makes him able to know whether or not something "makes sense" for placement and details. He's always on the aim for perfection for the benefit of you.
Consumables: Artisan ink offers an extra kick to your energy for time consuming tattoos - free beverages and snacks to make sure you remain steady during the sessions. (Patrick even ordered donuts for the team, and offered me to have some as well)

All in all - This is the place to go in Chiang Mai. Hygiene is the best you'll find the shop is aesthetically pleasing to look at.
So if you want astounding service and care with siginificant professionalism for a very reasonable and afforable price, then please, do yourself a favor and step into ARTISAN INK to get not just a tattoo for your life but also an experience for life.

Thank you Patrick and Co. See you soon.

Great experience today at Artisan Ink Chiang Mai, booked in advance and popped in prior to appointment to discuss options and ideas on 2 different tattoos.. ran through some options and went away, before appointment sent me over some ideas to think on before showing for the tattoo..

English speaking so for anyone unsure please don't be, I reached out on whatsapp way before so were sure on the place.

Firstly the shop is super clean, from the minute you walk in. bright, airy, clean and welcoming. Different artists were used as we had 2 tattoos done (wife and myself) all tattoo were done well away from the shopfront so very private which is important for some people..

The designs we went for were inspired by our guidelines but created by the shop and we amended them both slightly further with absolutely pressure to accept their designs until we were 100% happy... this was reiterated a few times so we were certain we were comfortable before we went ahead.

My design came better than expected/planned and I am absolutely over the moon with the work done..

My wife's design was changed 2/3 times once drawn, and when placed changed again for the perfect finished piece and she's delighted with the outcome aswell.

Couldn't recommend more highly..

Thanks guys,

Dan and Claire

This tattoo shop is unlike any other shop. It is a beautiful bright, clean establishment. I felt so comfortable with the staff, from my first walk in meeting to spending as much time as necessary perfecting my 3/4 arm sleeve.  Patrick is the most welcoming guy and is extremely detailed and cares deeply about working with the artist and myself to come up with a perfect design that I absolutely loved.  Jean was my artist and let me tell you he has a steady, light hand and applied the ink perfectly.  We did a straight 11 hour session and he did such crisp, clean lines, shading and some added color.  Im in love with the design we created together, Jean perfected it and even did some free hand to finish off a section on my shoulder.  Hands down the best tattoo shop in Chaing Mai.  I highly recommend you coming here to make your Mark at artisan ink. I wish I had more time to do my inner arm sleeve but time is limited for my trip. If I ever come back im coming here.  They have so many experienced tattoo artist and offer a wide range of designs from tribal to traditional. I couldn't praise this shop more, customer service is unmatched. They were constantly checking on my needs throughout and even called a grab ride to take me back to my hotel.  Im so blessed I found this shop. Such a different take then your average tattoo shop. Its absolutely gorgeous!! 100 starts still isn't enough to express how good this shop is.

Huge thanks to Patrick, Artist Jean and the whole team for the masterpiece tattoo.

Got my tattoos at Artisan Ink Tattoo and they turned out great. Went fist night to get a elephant Tattoo, loved the art work; went the next night again for a second tattoo. The detail is super clean, and the whole experience was easy and chill. Really happy with the work.

From the moment I reached out (with very quick and prompt responses by them) to planning the tattoo to the finished product, absolutely flawless and efficient without compromising quality. Patrick and his team will take care of you and make you feel at home and comfortable. He took care of my family and he’ll take of you and yours.

Big thank you Katie for the BEAUTIFUL custom piece and Miaa for the smaller piece. If you’re reading this, don’t hesitate to go here. Thank you again guys!

TLDR - Book the tattoo!

From the second we walked in, Patrick and the rest of the team (Minnie, Ploy, Katie + Terry) welcomed us warmly, treated us with kindness, professionalism and respect, were patient with answering all of our questions, happily worked with us on our designs, made sure we were all on the same page regarding pricing before we walked out the door with quotes and provided the reassurance I was looking for when booking a new studio we had never been to before. The studio itself is absolutely immaculate. You know it’s clean the second you walk in because your nose feels as though it’s been transported to a hospital back in Australia. There’s not a speck of dust in the whole place and this goes for all floors and areas, not just the main reception. Every single floor is clean, comfortable, private and well equipped. Toilet on every floor for convenience. Snacks and drinks are well stocked and you’re constantly checked on throughout. My entire family all got tattoos and the calibre of work is beyond anything I could have imagined. I had tattoos from both Terry and Katie. Katie was the artist for my lion fish and coral, Terry for my bigger leg piece. The whole process was seamless and crazy to say, almost painless. Both artists as well as the shop owners (Pat + Minnie) constantly checking on me throughout from making sure I was happy with the stencil placement, comfortable in the chair, checking if I needed a break, drink, snack, air turned up or down, different music or a show on the tv. I couldn’t have been better looked after. The after care was also exceptional. Thorough details on how and when to remove second skin as well as aftercare cream actually being provided in a beautifully presented envelope. The team has also sent photos and checked in on us since leaving. 2 days later and we can’t feel our tattoo’s at all. If we couldn’t see them we would not know they were there. I cannot rate Artisan ink high enough, 5 stars is nowhere near a good enough rating! The service, the cleanliness, the calibre of work is extraordinary, the price is extremely reasonable, the friendliest team we have ever had the please of meeting. We walked in wary of going to a new studio, we walked out knowing we will never go anywhere else, sorry guys, you’re stuck with us now 🫶🏽

Do yourself a favour and go in for a chat, there’s zero pressure to actually book a tattoo but I guarantee you will!

Had such an amazing experience here, from walking in the door to leaving. Made you feel welcome and comfortable. Very clean environment and amazing staff. Went above and beyond. I gave them a photo of what I wanted my tattoo to be based off and they turned it into something even more amazing for me.

I absolutely loved the atmosphere in this shop! Patrick was knowledgeable and welcoming, checking in with not only the design and placement process but also during the tattoo. The overall process was very clean. Clearly explained aftercare and gave free aftercare ointment. The quality of the work was astounding, especially the fine line work and command of color. I can't wait to heal my piece!

I strongly recommend this tattoo shop in Nimman, Chiang Mai if you’re looking for a reasonable price, excellent customer service, a spacious & clean shop and beautiful tattoo result. They have 7 experienced tattoo artists in the house! Very happy with their service & love my new tattoo.. 💗

Exceptional experience from start to finish. The studio is spotless, highly professional, and makes you feel comfortable immediately. The artist showed incredible precision, attention to detail, and true mastery of the craft. You can …

Hands down the best tattoo experience I've ever had!

My expectations of having ample time for testing things, getting opinions, and printing various form and sizes of my chosen design turned out to be the least you could ask for here, and I absolutely loved it ❤️

The staff are super nice and Patrick himself is exactly the type of guy you'd like to discuss with

Cant wait to be back in Chiang Mai one day and visit them again 💯🤞

Wow what a wonderful experience with Patrick and his entire team.  Great hospitality, super clean environment, top notch skilled artists and all at a reasonable cost.  This shop will not disappoint.  Just go and let them give you that tattoo or two that you always wanted.  My husband and I are super happy with their work and will be happy to refer any friends who plans to visit Chiang Mai and want to get inked..

Thank you so much for a great experience! My (over 20 year old) tattoo was faded and sad, I wanted an Orchid flower added to celebrate and symbolize my love of Thailand, and I hoped the old tat could be improved.
Mayaa went above and beyond; with huge talent, a gentle hand and dedication - to give me something to be proud of! She took much longer than expected, (with no extra charge) to make every detail perfect. Patrick is lovely and completely focussed on making sure that I was happy throughout the day.
We were all astonished by the transformation, its like a new tattoo! I totally love it and cant thank you all enough. Highly recommended !!!

Great experience, it was my first tattoo so I was nervous and did not know what to expect. Everybody was nice, they explained everything to me and answered all of my questions. Patrick has a deep knowledge about tattoos and it shows. …

We wanted to have a tattoo arround our enkle but didn’t have that much experience with tattoos. But from the moment we got in contact with Patrick he helped us a lot. He was calm and we got such a good vibe from him, we did a second tattoo right after. The artists are amazing and really talented. We trusted them completly and for the right reasons, the results are amazing. Afterwards you get great instructions on how to take care of your tattoo. If you want a tattoo big or small and you are in Chiang Mai, go here!!

Best experience ever. The staff was polite and very patient. I was offered water and juice. My tatto artist was gental and very observant to my needs. She ask many times if I need a break. My tatto came out fabulous.

Great tattoo experience! Really nice,friendly,patient and passionate staff. They take their time for you untill you are happy. I appreciated the privacy, no walk in customers will see you! Katie is an amazing tattooer,i almost didnt feel her tattoo me.....it was more vibrating than hurting and her flowers look really nice,fine and shimmery! Thank you so much!!!

My wife and I spent the better part of our day today in the Artisan ink tattoo shop, as she was getting a decent sized shoulder/upper arm tattoo. When we arrived, we were Immediately greeted at the door with two cold Bottles of water. ( which was amazing as it was hot as ballz out!) The owner Patrick,  was working the front counter, greeted us, and Introduced himself.
He them proceeded to spend over an hour with my wife trying to find the right size and position for her new tattoo. He and his tattoo artist were extremely patient, and took as long as my wife needed to make sure it was perfect. We NEVER felt rushed. At this point, I decided I too, needed a tattoo, lol, so Patrick moved a few things around to make sure I could have the same tattoo artist as my wife. He name was Miaa, and she was amazing. Both my arms are sleeved with tattoos, so I've dealt with ALOT of tattoo artists, and Miaa was truly one of the best!
Due to both of us getting tattoos we were there for over 6 hours. That was enough time to see Patrick and all of his Tattoo artists deal with multiple Customers. And the service was always the same, exceptional! So if your ever in Chiang Mai, and want a tattoo, I can't recommend them enough!!
